titolo: Perplexity launches Orchestrator API unifying access to major LLM providers
descr: Perplexity's new Orchestrator API routes requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and open-weight models through a single endpoint with failover and unified billing.
paragrafi: Perplexity announced an Orchestrator API that lets developers call models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and open-weight providers via one API key.
The API supports OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages formats, and automatically selects a healthy deployment, retrying on failure.
Access to Google, xAI and open-weight models is available at all usage tiers, while OpenAI and Anthropic models require Tier 1 or Tier 2.
The service is stateless; each request must include the full conversation, and authentication is handled via a bearer token.
perche: The Orchestrator API simplifies integration for users who need to switch between providers without managing multiple keys or endpoints. It also offers a fallback mechanism, which can improve reliability for applications that rely on external LLM services, while keeping costs under a single credit balance.
